acceptance_note: Floors are accepted only when a supervisor-chosen strict ancestor of the candidate (run-quality-candidate.py --floors-anchor) holds an entry for the same corpus hash with review.status 'accepted-independent-review'. The candidate's own file cannot assert acceptance. To accept: after independent review of corpus labels, runner and floors, change review.status to 'accepted-independent-review', run `cd scripts && python3 -m quality_candidate.floors seal ../docs/quality/candidate-floors.json`, merge, and have CI pass the merged commit as the anchor.

review.justification: Floors equal the deterministic Q7 measurement on 2026-10-05 (offline TF-IDF provider; measured on the Q7 development tree and re-confirmed identical on clean candidate 12d2c3ba by an end-to-end runner execution) rounded down to 3 decimals, so any change that lowers a metric by one query-level step fails. They are regression detectors for this corpus, not a statement of acceptable retrieval quality: the relevance labels were authored by an LLM and no human has reviewed them. Raise only with a corpus/runner review; never lower to make a run pass.

review.label_review: frozen v1 smoke corpus; reviewed with docs/quality/budgets.json (Wave 3 independent post-review)
review.justification: The lexical floors repeat the already reviewed budgets.json retrieval floors (1.0) and the runner refuses any lower value. Hybrid floors are the measured 1.0 on 2026-10-05. Metrics of 1.0 on 9 memories prove plumbing only, not retrieval quality on customer-like data.
